validatedFacts: Bump-operated station tariffs are set by the site manager and displayed in the Bump app.
The exact applied tariff and tariff components are available by selecting the station / Voir le tarif.
Partner-network prices belong to the partner operator and must not be treated as Bump direct prices.
A minimum charge can apply only at some stations and is not a network-wide fallback.
failClosedRule: Use only the exact tariff returned/displayed for the exact Bump station/EVSE. Never extrapolate by power, site type, minimum-charge headline, nearby station, or partner-network price. Unqueried/unmatched stations remain unpriced.
